title: CPU AWGN and flat-fading channel stages
description:
## Goal

AWGN, Rayleigh, and Rician (frequency-flat) channel stages as
`Stage` impls with deterministic per-worker ChaCha20 noise
streams.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation for gf2-sim
pipeline) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] AWGN, Rayleigh, and Rician channel stages exposed as
  `Stage` impls in `gf2-sim`; per-worker ChaCha20 stream advances
  via `set_word_pos`; byte-identity across worker counts at
  fixed seed.

## Non-goals

Frequency-selective / multipath fading is out of scope (epic
`f9717e7e` non-goals).
